inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Are there any overhead electric poles, conductors, or power lines shown on this site plan sheet? If so, where are they located and do any buildings or structures appear to conflict with them?
inputs.regionHint: Check entire property boundary and adjacent right-of-way areas
